description: The airfares EclipseMission has read, each dated and sourced. Two families that must never be added together: Google Flights searches (return trip, two adults, as the search displayed it) and easyJet fares read at the airline (one seat, one way). Filter by departure airport, destination, or both. A route we have not read is absent, which is not a claim that no flight exists.

destination.description: The destination key, as list_destinations returns it.

origin.description: IATA code of the departure airport, e.g. CDG.
